purpose: Architectural LAW for the brand PORTFOLIO (owner-directed 2026-06-06; canonical doc docs/strategy/teleon-baltor-openhubforai-portfolio.md). A holding company owns three product layers: OpenHubForAI (open ecosystem + the open CapabilityTask spec), Teleon (the purpose-driven runtime SaaS), and Baltor (the applied product, a TENANT of Teleon). This file encodes the allowed/forbidden IMPORT directions so the boundary is enforced by a proof (scripts/check_portfolio_dependency_law.py), not by prose. Branch on the layer + edge, never on a brand display name.
law: Baltor depends on Teleon; Teleon may consume OpenHubForAI artifacts; OpenHubForAI depends on neither. Teleon must NEVER import Baltor (it is reusable infrastructure, not a Baltor feature). OpenHubForAI must import neither (the open ecosystem/spec stays neutral).

openhubforai.role: open ecosystem — eval harnesses, task templates, conformance tests, skills, runtime-adapter examples, example CapabilityTasks, and the OPEN CapabilityTask spec. The neutral home of the standard.

teleon.role: purpose-driven runtime SaaS — PurposeTask registry, runtime selector, implementation candidates, evidence ledger, promotion gate, policy engine, boundary approvals, task orientation, runtime adapters, assurance dashboard. The reference implementation of the open CapabilityTask spec.

baltor.role: applied product — customer workflows, domain-specific tasks, source/evidence UX, receipts, vertical integrations, Baltor business logic. A TENANT/consumer of Teleon (tenant_id baltor-internal).

forbidden_edges.why: Teleon must not become Baltor-specific; it is reusable infrastructure usable by any product
the open ecosystem must not require the applied product
the open ecosystem/spec stays neutral; Teleon consumes OHH, not the reverse

vocabulary.CapabilityTask: the formal/spec name for the same object (open standard, stewarded by OpenHubForAI)
vocabulary.EvidenceLedger: runs, evals, traces, receipts, scorecards, cost, latency, safety checks
vocabulary.PromotionGate: the evidence + policy decision before a candidate promotion
vocabulary.BoundaryApproval: human approval for new permissions/systems/data-access/runtime-classes/purpose expansion (an ends change)
vocabulary.TaskOrientation: structured operational memory: failure modes, environment facts, rejected strategies, successful migrations
vocabulary.AssurancePortal: customer/staff visibility into purpose, evidence, health, approvals, outputs, trust

lessons: Pre-grep must include LAZY (inside-function) ABSOLUTE imports (e.g. `from src.baltor.workers.durable_fleet_ledger import ...` inside a method) — a top-level import grep misses them and they create a teleon->baltor edge after a move.

Pre-grep for private re-export must catch `from <mod> import _NAME` (explicit-name imports of underscore privates, incl _UPPERCASE like _JOB_BACKENDS), not just `module._name` attribute access — proofs import privates by name (check_runtime_class_binding imported _JOB_BACKENDS/_POOL_BACKENDS).
